IncidentDef.label: contaminated Stargate salvage
IncidentDef.letterText: Apparently inert modular machine substrate has appeared near the colony's Stargate after off-world traffic. It is not an active Replicator, but its internal lattice may become dangerous if the material is left unsecured.

IncidentDef.label: Replicator Stargate incursion
IncidentDef.letterText: The Stargate has opened onto a hostile Replicator-controlled corridor. Primitive block forms are entering through the exact gate, with bounded follow-on redials possible while that same corridor remains usable.
